page_note: Heavily damaged page (80.6%) presenting pure cosmological-correspondential substrate teaching about the body-cosmos correspondence: great limbs joined to the body, the small wellsprings rooted in them, the 'standing-fast' (ⲧⲱⲕ ⲁⲣⲉⲧϥ̄) as their operation, and the analogy of Hyle/matter with her powers in the abyss of the storehouses, whose natures when separated leave the elements 'argon' (inactive). The teaching deploys the soul-body analogy ('when the soul comes forth from him, no operation exists in him') as a likening (ⲡⲓⲧⲁⲛⲧⲛ̄) for the cosmic process. No editorial markers, no dialogue frame, no hortatory voice, no institutional vocabulary. Voice is impersonal-systematic throughout. The Greek loanwords (ϩⲩⲗⲏ, ⲫⲩⲥⲓⲥ, ⲉⲛⲉⲣⲅⲓⲁ, ⲁⲣⲅⲟⲛ, ⲯⲩⲭⲏ) are the Coptic translator's standard rendering vocabulary for the underlying Iranian/correspondential physics.
